text: End your _sadness_. Many feel _sad_ seeing that __face__ of yours....
author: (c) 2022 Pak Bogor Putih

text: Everything is according to __His will__.
author: (c) 2025 H. Syaiful Anwar

text: __No need__ to change anything. You are ___perfect___ in the eyes of those who _love_.
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Let those who __dislike__ you be. __Do not change__ just for _them_. Life is __only once__, __do not follow__ other people's words.
author: (c) 2025 Bu Yus M3A

text: Everyone __surely__ has _flaws_ and _strengths_, has _disgrace_ and _honor_. ___Look at their strengths, look at their dignity.___
author: (c) 2025 Tn. Guru Ilmi Kerang

text: _Classy_ jokes, not jokes that __invade privacy__.
author: (c) 2025 Ust. Muhammad Rusli

text: Just stay _calm_ and _feel_ ... that __not everything can be told__.
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Just _pretending_, so they see us ___happy___ ....
author: (c) 2025 Rahmat Tahalu

text: __Educate your heart__ to _not be arrogant_ and __feel__ _superior_, and __educate your eyes__ not to __look down__ on others.
author: (c) 2025 Tn. Guru Sanjaya Kerang Dayo

text: __Gratitude__ makes __us content__, a _haircut_ makes us ___good-looking___.
author: (c) 2025 Zoro Barbershop Kerang

text: It's okay. No human is ___perfect___ ... perfection __belongs only to Allah SWT.__ _Thank you_ ....
author: (c) 2025 Pak Bejo Riyatno M3A

text: There is no such thing as __a wrong path__, everyone _fights_ with ___their own destiny___.
author: (c) 2025 Thariq Batu Kajang

text: __Loving you__ is like seawater; tides will _always exist_, but the taste ___never changes___.
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Learn from __mistakes__, not _from regret._
author: (c) 2025 Muhammad Rama Danu

text: After everything ended, I __don't want__ to disturb you anymore, because that is a ___promise___ I made _to myself_ long ago.
author: (c) 2025 Zaldy Firmansyah

text: ___Worship___ should not be _treated_ as a transaction, but as __a connection__.
author: (c) 2025 Fildhatul Hammi

text: We _may_ love them, but let them __love their own choice.__
author: (c) 2025 Nur Melii

text: Act normally.
author: (c) 2025 Ahmedeeya

text: It reminds me of the _past_. We were __so close__ back then ... but ___now ...._
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: If we were __not given__ food, ___do not expect us___ to work.
author: (c) 2025 Hendry Noor

text: We will _never be perfect or right_, in the eyes of __haters__.
author: (c) 2025 Guru Wandi Tebru Paser Damai

text: Someone __cannot__ feel the same thing if they are in a ___different position___.
author: (c) 2025 Ahmedeeya

text: Life is like playing __Angry Bird__. If we lose, there are pigs that __laugh__.
author: (c) 2025 Nurhadi-Aldo

text: I no longer _force_ that communication. __Just contact__ me when needed, __find me__ when you need me.
author: (c) 2025 Intan Qurratu'ain

text: You slept __too long__, until they _forgot_ that you are ___not a beginner___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin Tiramisu Cake

text: Many people _give examples_, but __few__ _become examples_. Giving examples is _easy_, but becoming one is ___hard___.
author: (c) 2025 KH Zainuddin MZ

text: __Stay away__ if it is _for your own good_.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: And _come closer_ so you _know_ how ___cruel I am___.
author: (c) 2025 Darken

text: _Thank you_. __Sorry__. ___Please___.
author: (c) 2025 Lite

text: If you __already know__, then go ___away___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: __Speak__ to people _according_ to their __capacity__. Speak __to educate__, ___not to judge___.
author: (c) 2025 Ust. Muhammad Rusli

text: _Face_ it with a smile. If you want to _join_, continue. If not, ___that's fine___.
author: (c) 2025 Pak Jimmie M3A

text: No need to __celebrate__ Mother's and Father's Day; you see them _every day_, just __obey and be devoted__. Sometimes those who celebrate ___do not truly love___ them.
author: (c) 2025 Danang M3A

text: __Regret__ comes _at the end_; if at the beginning, it is called ___registration___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: When you _find_ yourselves __happy without any reason__, then __know__, at that moment __Allah__ is ___pleased___ with you.
author: (c) 2026 Syekh Mutawalli Sya'rawi
